name: @mercatus-liber/customization-ui
description: Default, out-of-the-box UI for product customization (subsystem: customization) -- a real, usable Web Component (Custom Element), not just a data contract. Built as a Custom Element specifically so it embeds into any frontend (React, Angular, Vue, a plain page) without a framework-specific build step, the same pattern @google/model-viewer already proves out in shop.mdostal.com's own PDPs. Ships alongside @mercatus-liber/customization (the framework-agnostic data model + resolution logic + persistence, owned separately) -- this package is pure rendering, no persistence, no network calls. Pending @mercatus-liber/customization's real types landing, this package's resolution logic (resolveEffectiveColor) is a faithful local port (same rules: single/palette/any color modes, separable/parent-follows regions, allowed-color lists, active/discontinued/request availability) -- swap to depending on the real package once it ships, rather than maintaining two copies.
